::: {.callout-warning}
**Individual Assignment hanya dinilai kalau Tutorial minggu yang sama sudah diselesaikan** - kalau belum, Individual Assignment tersebut tidak akan dinilai meskipun sudah dikumpulkan. Deadline Tutorial adalah hari Rabu itu sendiri (tidak harus selesai persis saat sesi lab); deadline Individual Assignment adalah Senin minggu berikutnya. Lihat tanggal lengkap tiap minggu di [halaman Jadwal](../index.qmd#jadwal-semester).
:::

1. Penilaian individu terdiri dari **Individual Assignment mingguan** (rilis dan deadline seminggu kemudian, mengikuti topik Tutorial minggu itu) dan **Programming Quiz** (via SCELE, lihat halaman Jadwal untuk tanggalnya).
2. Individual Assignment akan muncul di menu ini satu per satu, seiring tutorial minggu terkait selesai dipublish.
3. Setiap Individual Assignment mensyaratkan Tutorial minggu yang sama sudah diselesaikan - kerjakan tutorialnya dulu, karena tanpa itu Individual Assignment-nya tidak dinilai.
4. Apabila terdapat kesulitan, mahasiswa dapat bertanya kepada asisten dosen melalui media komunikasi yang sudah ditentukan.
:::
::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
::: {.callout-warning}
**An Individual Assignment is only graded if that same week's Tutorial has been completed** - if it hasn't, the Individual Assignment won't be graded even if submitted. A Tutorial's deadline is that same Wednesday (not necessarily finished exactly during the lab session); its Individual Assignment's deadline is the following Monday. See exact dates for every week on the [Schedule page](../index.qmd#semester-schedule).
:::

1. Individual assessment consists of a **weekly Individual Assignment** (released and due a week later, following that week's Tutorial topic) and a **Programming Quiz** (via SCELE, see the Schedule page for dates).
2. Individual Assignments will appear in this menu one at a time, as each related tutorial week is published.
3. Every Individual Assignment requires that same week's Tutorial to be completed first - do the tutorial first, since without it the Individual Assignment won't be graded.
4. If you run into difficulties, students may ask teaching assistants questions through the designated communication channel.
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="id"}
